name: HarnessBench
notes: Sister project of ClawBench. The repository holds the harness-bench CLI (harness x model x task matrix expansion with credential gating, run, batch and a leaderboard renderer over ClawBench result summaries), six harness adapters (openclaw, hermes, claw-code, browser-use, stagehand, coze-studio), each a Dockerfile, setup script and run script built on the clawbench-base image, and a one-task smoke fixture. The tasks, the five-layer recording and the judge belong to ClawBench; this repository holds the harness, whose run and batch commands call clawbench.run_case and require clawbench-eval 0.2.0 or later. At the inspected commit the README's fixtures/lite.txt 20-task subset is absent from the tree, the browser-use run script calls a run-browser-use.py that neither the tree nor its Dockerfile supplies, and the leaderboard and demo videos are placeholders. stagehand and coze-studio need BrowserBase or Coze credentials.
summary: Benchmark harness that holds the base model fixed and runs six browser-agent harnesses in per-harness containers on ClawBench's everyday online tasks, reusing ClawBench's recording and judging pipeline.
